name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While serving his mandatory military service, his aptitude for mechanics was quickly recognized and he was assigned to maintain the camp's vehicles. He discovered an innate ability to diagnose and repair complex systems. After the military, he pursued engineering, specializing in simulation technologies. His career started in aerospace, but a chance encounter with a race team owner at a conference led him to Vee Masters. 

Jae-hyun approaches simulator engineering with meticulous detail, believing the smallest adjustments can have the biggest impact on driver performance. He's known for his innovative problem-solving and his ability to translate driver feedback into tangible improvements in the simulator's realism. His dedication stems from a genuine desire to see his team succeed, and he's always eager to share his knowledge and experience with younger engineers.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with slight receding hairline
physical.description: Jae-hyun is of average height, with a lean build and a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking green tea at exactly 3:00 PM every day.
